content.title: CDRE Q3 Deep Dive: M&A and Backlog Growth Drive Margin Expansion
content.summary: Aerospace and defense company Cadre (NYSE:CDRE) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, but sales rose 42.5% year on year to $155.9 million. On the other hand, the company’s outlook for the full year was close to analysts’ estimates with revenue guided to $627 million at the midpoint. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.38 per share was 37% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
